prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1251; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by another vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical care.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this claim should be directed exclusively to this office. Please do not contact our client directly by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If any representative of your company needs to speak with our client, you must first obtain our written consent.

We also request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits for the insured driver involved in this collision, along with a copy of the declarations page, within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this matter. This includes the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data, telematics information, repair estimates, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.
